sources.clock_source: studio track (song.camera_check run by clock_studio: camera excluded from the base take)

warning: Unnumbered files may duplicate cameras. Audio propagation and A/V offset still require visual verification.
clock_kind: AUDIO clocks (as alignment.json): phone audio-video latency and speaker->phone sound travel (~2.9 ms/m) are not included; sync.py's video residual offsets measure what remains

provenance.method: per phone: studio -> phone-source affine fit y = a x + b (8 s onset-feature windows every 8 s, robust LS; song.camera_check) composed with studio -> reference: reference = (s / a) * source + (o - s b / a). cam06 = identity (the reference clock is cam06's audio).
provenance.anchors_note: anchors[]: source_start / reference_start are the 8 s studio window CENTRES on the phone's source clock and on the reference clock (through the song -> reference line); residual_seconds = reference_start - (slope * source_start + offset)

validation.accuracy_note: audio clocks: every phone within about +-1-2 ms of cam06's audio in the onset-envelope sense; the sub-ms fit residuals / medians below are precision from the same onset-feature machinery, not capture-time accuracy (raw-waveform correlation puts some phones ~10 ms elsewhere, cam03). VIDEO frame sync is not covered: see D and sync.py.

A_studio_track.method: each phone's audio mapped through the clock set vs the studio track mapped through song.json's song->reference fit; 4 s onset-feature windows every 1 s (centres 32.5-65.5 s), r >= 0.08; residual = clock(phone instant) - studio-line(same instant), ms; drift = robust line (outlier windows listed)

B_phones_only.method: every pair of phones (no studio track) mapped through the clock set, 8 s windows every 1.5 s (centres 34.5-63 s), r >= 0.08, psr >= 1.05; pair medians solved (weighted LS) for each phone's clock error with cam06 = 0. Independent of the studio track.

C_envelope_spot_check.note: peak of each phone's broadband onset envelope within +-60 ms of the studio onset (1 ms grid on 5 ms features); spread = max - min over phones at each onset

D_video_offsets_expected.note: delta_new = delta_old - clock change, median 0 (sync.py's gauge). The audio clocks do not remove the per-phone video offsets (A/V latency, sound travel): sync.py must measure them on the new take before any MAMMA fit.
